text: Kwabena went to Achimota and met the Okuapenhene at Nyankpani.
The Bank of Ghana raised the policy rate, citing pressure on the cedi.
The convention discussed inflationary policy yesterday afternoon.
Yaw Mensah drove from Adenta through Madina to Kotoka.
Have you told Ama that the meeting at Ridge is postponed?
